stories.title: A week of rain displaces thousands in Midwest floods
stories.summary: Evacuations orders continue to be issued in Ohio following days of rain that has washed out roads and caused widespread flooding across Indiana and Illinois, too.

stories.title: Judge knocks down a National Firearms Act provision, handing win to gun rights groups
stories.summary: A federal judge's decision out of Texas has major implications for the National Firearms Act, lifting regulations on certain guns and suppressors in more than a dozen states.

stories.title: They fought for the U.S. in Afghanistan. Now they worry about losing their green cards
stories.summary: When the U.S. withdrew from Afghanistan five years ago, thousands of Afghans who helped U.S. troops were brought here to rebuild their lives. But now, some fear the U.S. may want to send them back.

stories.title: Why some companies are paying more than $1 million to get through the Panama Canal
stories.summary: With the Strait of Hormuz effectively closed, pressure on the Panama Canal has increased. And combined with lower water levels, transit prices through the canal are soaring.

stories.title: In 'The Wrong Girls,' Kristen Stewart and Alia Shawkat play messy stoner BFFs
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Dylan Meyer about her directorial debut, The Wrong Girls and the value of seeing women being silly and making dubious decisions onscreen.

stories.title: Ariana Grande's 'Petal' goes to No. 1 on the charts
stories.summary: NPR Music's Stephen Thompson reports on the commercial performance of the pop star's latest hit.
